assets.prompt: EDIT TARGET: the attached existing square RPG portrait frame. Redesign it into a MUCH THINNER CORNER-HUGGING frame while preserving its recognizable palette, materials, motifs and coarse pixel style. Keep black volcanic metal, orange magma and gold dragon-wing motifs. Make four SMALL angular dragon-wing corner ornaments, linked by a very fine molten-gold edge. All dragon heads and diamonds must be corner-sized, never large centered crests. Critical geometric constraints: square 1:1; think native 128x128 logical pixel sprite enlarged with nearest-neighbor. Edge connectors only 3-5 logical pixels thick (2.5-4% of canvas). Corner ornaments fit INSIDE the outermost 12x12 logical pixels at each extreme corner (under 10% of canvas). No opaque pixels anywhere in the CENTRAL 78% square (x=11%..89%, y=11%..89%). Additionally the FACE SAFE RECTANGLE x=22%..78%, y=5%..60% must be completely alpha-transparent: this includes almost all of the upper center. No top-center crest, no suspended moon, no hanging gems, no broad decorations entering the portrait. Keep the upper-center border exceptionally plain and at most 3% thick. All decoration hugs the perimeter and corners, leaving the character and face unobscured. Genuine transparent alpha throughout the empty interior and outside irregular edges. Pixel style: visibly chunky square clusters, roughly 24-32 colors, dark 1 logical pixel outline, 3-4 flat shades. No smooth painted gradients, micro-textures or fine filigree. No character, scene, background, opaque glow, letters, digits, UI card, checkerboard. A game-ready transparent PNG, full square canvas, not a cropped strip. This is an actual newly drawn THIN version, not the previous thick frame shrunk into the center.
